title: Annotation OCR Correction Backlog
dataSources: Highlights (`reading:highlight`), book activity (`reading:book`), reviews (`reading:review`), paper libraries (`research:paper`), sync states (`reading:sync`).
app: Reading and second-brain telemetry — Readwise review exports, Kindle highlights, Goodreads shelves, and Zotero research libraries — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reading:sync source_name=* ocr_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(ocr_state!="corrected",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by source_name
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending OCR corrections backlog by source for annotation cleanup.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside annotation cleanup.
implementation: Mark each `reading:sync` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `source_name`.
visualization: Table of source with pending OCR corrections counts.
grandmaExplanation: It turns where unfinished OCR corrections are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in annotation cleanup.
